notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI realizes the photo-booth idea end to end for the main slots: PortraitRenderTarget bakes the live dressed model once per appearance change (dirty-flag driven, with retry), framed by the model's authored portrait camera with a bounds-heuristic fallback (Benilla's exact source ladder), pre-masked to the inscribed circle at bake time, with the reference's TemporaryPortrait-{Sex}-{Race}/-Monster stand-ins while loading. The paper-doll and inspect windows get full-body bakes with live rotation, and the glue booth renders char-select/create through the scene's authored camera 0 + attachment 0, matching glue_booth.rs.
